entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who gifted Jace a quick death and mourns him, then helps Liliana carry his body out and later visits Ranna Beleren.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage who dies, his spark leaving his body to find Tam; he is laid to rest as a son of Vryn.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The part of Jace who merged the Multiverses; Tam knows in her heart he is dead.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A being made by Jace to inherit his spark; she calls Emrakul to devour the Echoverse, gains his spark and memories, and planeswalks home as a real person.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who mourns Jace, fights the doubles of Garruk and others, and drags Vraska and Jace's body out through a mage-ring.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who embraces Vraska and planeswalks away to Vryn.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who tells the others to leave Jace's spark and fights his double.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A druid planeswalker who blames Liliana's curse for ruining him, then asks about the twins and spares her.

entities.name: Cryomancer Chandra
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Chandra who freezes the ground and Liliana's dress; she fades to a ghost.

entities.name: Garruk's double
aliases: the Garruk with the Chain Veil
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Garruk who wields the Chain Veil and beasts, fading to a ghost.

entities.name: Ajani's double
entities.description: The Echoverse double of Ajani, turned to stone by Vraska's gaze.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: The lich of Professor Opal that Liliana controls as her puppet and which fades from existence.

entities.name: Emrakul
aliases: the beast that lives within the moon
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan Tam calls to devour the false Multiverse; she engulfs the sky and consumes the Echoverse.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who asks Tam who she is and introduces themself.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who hugs Tam.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A winged Strixhaven student who hugs Tam.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A Strixhaven student who refuses to join the hug.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An innocent oracle whose death Tam says is her responsibility.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother, who shares tea with Vraska while mourning.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A member of Ranna's household practicing the Ravnican alphabet.

entities.name: Ingris Stingerquill
entities.description: A Founder Sphinx of Hexhaven who fights Emrakul.

entities.name: Uldaros Theorix
entities.description: A sphinx whose matter is smeared toward Emrakul's mouth as she distinguishes planes.

entities.name: The Kenrith twins
entities.description: Twins about whom Garruk asks and whom Liliana says she cares for, worrying about the girl.

entities.name: Founder Sphinxes of Hexhaven
entities.description: Sphinxes that marshal to fight Emrakul.

entities.name: Hexhaven cadets
entities.description: The blank-eyed cadets of Hexhaven, including Vigorbloom, Theorix and Konstrari groups.

entities.name: Strixhaven students
entities.description: The students of Strixhaven who survive in the Echoverse and cheer Emrakul.

entities.name: The Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact carried by Garruk's double that alarms Liliana.

entities.name: Jace's spark
entities.description: A brilliant blue light that rises from Jace's chest and sinks into Tam, giving her his powers and memories.

entities.name: The Echoverse
entities.description: The mirrored Multiverse the Theorist created, collapsing into the original and consumed by Emrakul.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The mirror-version of Strixhaven in the Echoverse, with a tower and cadets.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school where Tam and her friends return.

entities.name: The Folioplex
entities.description: A building at Hexhaven whose back holds a mage-ring.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane with the moon where Emrakul is bound.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: The plane where Jace is buried and Chandra says they will go.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose double fades; Ranna's friend lives there.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane whose double has snow that gives way to sun.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The monstrous race to which Emrakul belongs.

events.summary: Vraska holds Jace's body and weeps as Chandra and Ajani embrace her; Liliana kneels and mourns him.
events.quote: Vraska holds the body of her beloved and weeps.

events.summary: Jace's spark rises from his chest as a blue light and shoots through an open window; Liliana demands to know what he did.
events.quote: the spark continues its climb up, out of his chest

events.summary: The spark falls like a meteor and strikes Tam in the chest, filling her with energy and emotion.
events.quote: It hits her in the chest, and she gasps.

events.summary: Tam reaches out with her mind to Emrakul and asks her to feast on the false Multiverse.
events.quote: Will you feast at my invitation?

events.summary: Emrakul agrees, promising to devour and to heal.
events.quote: I will come to devour and to heal.

events.summary: Tam feels new dreams and wants from the spark and realizes the Echoverse is crashing into the original.
events.quote: She wants to learn how to ride a horse .

events.summary: Emrakul engulfs the sky over Hexhaven.
events.quote: Emrakul engulfs the sky.

events.summary: Emrakul opens her mouth and begins devouring the Echoverse, and doubles of planes fade.
events.quote: As the mirrored plane shakes and sputters, it begins to fade.

events.summary: Tam finds Kirol, Sanar, Abigale and Lluwen at the Folioplex and apologizes for what happened to Jadzi and to them.
events.quote: What happened to Jadzi is my responsibility.

events.summary: Tam chooses a name, introducing herself to Kirol as Just Tam.
events.quote: "I'm Tam. Just Tam."

events.summary: Tam directs her friends to the mage-ring and sends them home to Strixhaven.
events.quote: "Mage-ring at the back of the Folioplex," she replies

events.summary: The tower fades, and the doppelgangers of Chandra, Garruk and Ajani step out of a portal and attack.
events.quote: One of the portals in the center of the sanctum glows, and out step their doppelgängers.

events.summary: Vraska turns Ajani's double to stone with her gaze.
events.quote: Stone overtakes fur, and the doppelgänger dies with a snarl on his face.

events.summary: Liliana senses Emrakul overhead and deduces that Jace's spark went to one specific body.
events.quote: Liliana remembers the spark emerging from Jace's chest, flying out the window, seeking a body.

events.summary: The doubles vanish, and a mage-ring appears as a way home; Ajani and Chandra planeswalk away.
events.quote: Liliana sees a flash of light as the two of them planeswalk away.

events.summary: Garruk blames Liliana's curse and asks if she knows the twins; she says she cares for them, and he planeswalks away.
events.quote: "I will not forgive you, witch, but tell me the truth and I will spare you. Do you know the twins?"

events.summary: Liliana returns for Vraska and Jace's body and they haul him through the mage-ring away from the false Multiverse.
events.quote: Together, Liliana and Vraska haul Beleren's body through the mage-ring, away from the false Multiverse.

events.summary: Founder Sphinxes and cadets fight Emrakul as she distinguishes one plane from another and pulls matter into her maw.
events.quote: "She is distinguishing one plane from the other!"

events.summary: Hexhaven is marked as separate from Strixhaven and begins being drawn into the sky.
events.quote: Around her, Hexhaven is marked separate from Strixhaven.

events.summary: Jace's voice speaks in Tam's mind, telling her she is his fail-safe and she inherits his spark.
events.quote: I made you so you could inherit mine.

events.summary: Tam is complete, becoming real for the first time and recognizing herself as a clean slate.
events.quote: For the first time in her existence, she knows exactly who she is.

events.summary: Tam's eyes alight with blue and she planeswalks home to Strixhaven.
events.quote: Tam's eyes alight with blue.

events.summary: After Jace's funeral, Vraska sits with Ranna Beleren as a quiet morning passes.
events.quote: He was laid to rest as a son of Vryn

events.summary: Tam arrives at Ranna's door, introduces herself to Vraska and says she is here to help make things better; Ranna drops her teacups on seeing Tam.
events.quote: "I'm here to help make things better."

relations.note: Jace made Tam to inherit his spark.
relations.quote: I made you so you could inherit mine.

relations.note: Vraska mourns Jace as her beloved.
relations.quote: Vraska holds the body of her beloved and weeps.

relations.note: Vraska stayed with Ranna, Jace's mother, after his death.
relations.quote: Vraska sits with Ranna Beleren once again.

relations.note: Emrakul responds to Tam's invitation and later says you're welcome.
relations.quote: The electrons around her quiver. You're welcome.

relations.note: Garruk blames her curse for ruining him.
relations.quote: "Your curse ruined me," the druid snarls.

relations.note: She cares for both, worrying about the girl.
relations.quote: I care for them both, but I worry about the girl.
The sight of the Chain Veil alarms Liliana

relations.note: Liliana raised the lich of Professor Opal and controls it as her puppet.
relations.quote: mentally instructs the lich of Professor Opal to stand back to back with her.
